runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reaches only the opaque entry list fields and the three opaque blob shapes
all seven ports are dependency-only, so the row build and the box apply are unverified in this package

the frame byte at [EBP-0x6b] and the frame slot at [EBP-0x58] are never written by the 223 instruction body, so the fallback call's third argument and the build port's first argument carry indeterminate values at run time
the receiver identity of the box apply port is the destination base plus twenty four times the index, which the decompilation inverts
decompilation_defects_corrected: the frame byte at [EBP-0x6b] is read at 0x004ad737 by MOVZX EDX and pushed as the third word of the fallback call, and the 223 instruction body was scanned for any write to that slot without finding one, so the argument is explicitly uninitialised and the model says so
the frame slot at [EBP-0x58] is referenced only by the LEA at 0x004ad7f2 that forms the build port's first argument, and is never written, so the model passes an explicitly indeterminate slot
the tail triple at self + 0xd4 is never read on the fallback path; the second stack word is self + 0xcc, not self + 0xd4

the constant at 0x013ef54c is the four bytes cd cc 8c 3f, that is little endian 0x3f8ccccd, which is the canonical single precision encoding of 1.1: the mantissa field is 0x0ccccd, that is 838861, and 838861 over two to the twenty third is 0.1. The two readers are 0x004ad8ca MOVSS XMM0, dword ptr [0x013ef54c] and 0x004ad8ef with the same form, and each feeds one of the two 0x0041dba0 calls through the stack slots at [EBP-0x5c] and [EBP-0x60].

the decompilation calls the box apply with the local box first and an uninitialised register second; the assembly at 0x004ada15 pushes the box address and loads ECX with the destination base plus twenty four times the index, so the receiver is the destination and the argument is the box
the decompilation omits the push and pop of ESI and EDI, so the corrected model keeps the shared epilogue at 0x004ada2e intact

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400).
